kind: document store with bounded undo/redo (history statefulness)
stateful_because: every mutation appends to a bounded undo journal; undo/redo outcomes depend on the entire mutation history and on cap-trimming; redo is invalidated by new mutations but survives no-op removes; insertion order interacts with undo conventions
bloat_character: operation-object polymorphism (SetOperation/RemoveOperation), journal classes with depth mirrors, verbose validators with flag variables, unused summarize_rules helper, manual loops for list copies
constraints: deterministic, no I/O, no wall clock, no randomness
